company_name: United Continental Holdings, Inc. (fka Continental Airlines, Inc.)

fuel_consumption.source_quote: The Company's 2017 forecasted fuel consumption is presently approximately four billion gallons, and based on this forecast, a one dollar change in the price of a barrel of crude oil would change the Company's annual fuel expense by approximately $95 million.

instrument_type_details.notes: As of December 31, 2016, no outstanding fuel hedging contracts. Company's current strategy is to not enter into transactions to hedge its fuel consumption. The last remaining hedges (from the 2015 fiscal year period, expiring December 2016) have now expired.

warnings: UAL adopted policy of no fuel hedging as of December 31, 2016. Prior hedging program formally discontinued.
